summary: NAS100 daily structure remains bullish (HH/HL) after a 3-day rally off the Aug 23 swing low at 28,872. However, price is sitting at 50.2% of the D1 dealing range and 73.3% of the H4 range (premium), and yesterday's D1 candle closed as a weak bearish bar (6% body) at the FIB 50% (29,559). Yesterday's bias call was Bearish Medium-High; the rally has stalled at equilibrium with a fresh bearish M15 FVG forming overhead. Neutral-bearish lean into Friday — weekend risk and premium positioning argue against fresh longs, but the bullish D1 structure argues against aggressive shorts.
